      protected abstract <I, O> void addLearnerVariants(Alphabet<I> alphabet, TimedQueryOracle<I,O> mqOracle, LearningExample.MMLTLearningExample<I,O> example, LearnerVariantList.MMLTLearnerVariantList<I,O> variants)
      Adds, for a given setup, all the variants of the MMLT learner to be tested to the specified variant list.
      Type Parameters:
      I - input symbol type (of non-delaying inputs)
      O - output symbol type
      Parameters:
      alphabet - the input alphabet
      mqOracle - the membership oracle
      example - the learning example to potentially extract additional information
      variants - the list to add the learner variants to
